file_name: OCTA - Woodside-EDL LNG JV - Questionnaire - October 2026.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if OCTA (either directly or through its subsidiaries CEFA and EVOL LNG) and WEJV are close competitors and there are not many alternatives in any particular geographic region.

Explain the extent to which alternative hydrocarbons (such as diesel) or renewable energy sources can be used as an alternative to trucked LNG for remote energy generation, including in relation to primary generation or for firming capacity.

Describe the ability of remote energy generation customers to switch fuel sources for remote energy generation, either to an alternative hydrocarbon or to renewable energy sources, including any ability to switch during the life of a project.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with OCTA and/or WEJV.
